prompt.project_info: Four-concept portrait collection adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Four clearly adult original women in distinct concepts: a red-haired woman crouching in a yellow-and-white swimsuit with pink sunglasses and a disco ball against a green backdrop; a brunette woman in a white tank top looking away in soft indoor natural light; a red-haired woman with long curls in light-blue athletic wear performing a full middle split in an empty wood-floored room; and a brown-haired woman in a white silk slip dress seated on a chair with a hand on her chin in a lounge or hotel room.
prompt.composition_elements: Treat each concept as a separate portrait panel with its own setting, wardrobe, pose and props; keep the four subjects visually distinct and do not merge scenes. Use close-up portrait framing where specified and a mirror-selfie framing only for the athletic split concept.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use natural soft light for the brunette close-up, bright playful studio light for the green-backdrop swimsuit concept, clean indoor light for the athletic mirror scene and warm gentle lounge light for the silk-dress portrait.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic portrait collection with realistic skin and fabric texture, correct anatomy and varied framing; preserve the distinct source concept of each panel.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create four separate photorealistic portrait concepts with clearly adult original women: a red-haired woman crouching in a yellow-and-white swimsuit with pink sunglasses and a disco ball on a green backdrop; a brunette in a white tank top looking away under soft indoor natural light; a long-curly-red-haired woman in light-blue athletic wear performing a full middle split in an empty wood-floored room as a mirror selfie; and a brown-haired woman in a white silk slip dress seated on a chair with her hand on her chin in a lounge or hotel room. Keep each panel distinct, naturally lit, anatomically correct and text-free.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, transparent clothing, exposed underwear, unsafe split anatomy, logos, text, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, extra fingers, duplicate subjects, merged scenes
